    - name: Strict actionlint YAML duplicate keys ShellCheck and pins
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        archive=project/VEUX_R39_R2_MEMORY_ABI_MAIN.zip
        printf '%s  %s\n' '745d80b8502a9beea513a2e7a58bb59272539b7508920d235ce2e79741bda528' "$archive" | sha256sum -c -
        unzip -p "$archive" tools/actionlint > "$R55_STAGE/actionlint"
        chmod 0755 "$R55_STAGE/actionlint"
        "$R55_STAGE/actionlint" -version | grep -Fx '1.7.12'
        "$R55_STAGE/actionlint" -color=false -shellcheck='' 'project/.github/workflows/VEUX_R55C1_SUSFS54_PROC_SUS_MAP_SOURCE_ONLY.yml' > "$R55_STAGE/R55C1_ACTIONLINT.log"
        printf 'R55C1_ACTIONLINT=PASS\n' >> "$R55_STAGE/R55C1_ACTIONLINT.log"
        python3 -B - <<'PY_R55C1_YAML_AUDIT'
        import pathlib,hashlib,subprocess,yaml
        class Unique(yaml.SafeLoader): pass
        def mapping(loader,node):
            output={}
            for kn,vn in node.value:
                k=loader.construct_object(kn)
                if k in output:raise RuntimeError('DUPLICATE_YAML_KEY:'+str(k))
                output[k]=loader.construct_object(vn)
            return output
        Unique.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG,mapping)
        w=yaml.load(pathlib.Path('project/.github/workflows/VEUX_R55C1_SUSFS54_PROC_SUS_MAP_SOURCE_ONLY.yml').read_text('utf-8'),Loader=Unique)
        assert list(w['on'])==['workflow_dispatch']
        assert w['permissions']=={'contents':'read'}
        assert set(w['jobs'])=={'r55c1_source'}
        j=w['jobs']['r55c1_source'];s=j['steps']
        assert j['runs-on']=='ubuntu-24.04'
        assert 'github.repository' in j['if'] and 'refs/heads/main' in j['if']
        assert len(s)==9
        for i in (0,1):
            assert s[i]['uses']=='actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683'
            assert s[i]['with']['persist-credentials'] is False
        assert s[1]['with']['repository']=='dereference23/kernel_xiaomi_sm6375'
        assert s[1]['with']['ref']=='b2b7a3bbc36d120ee523ebc8d68e0f13a97df632'
        assert s[8]['uses']=='actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02'
        assert s[8]['with']['if-no-files-found']=='error'
        logs=[]
        for step in s:
            if 'run' not in step:continue
            body=step['run']
            if chr(36)+chr(123) in body:raise RuntimeError('UNTRUSTED_GITHUB_EXPRESSION_IN_RUN_BLOCK')
            for cmd in (['bash','-n','-'],['shellcheck','--shell=bash','--severity=warning','-']):
                p=subprocess.run(cmd,input=body,text=True,capture_output=True)
                if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError('SHELL_INVALID:'+step['name']+':'+p.stdout+p.stderr)
            logs.append(step['name']+' BASH_SHELLCHECK_PASS SHA256='+hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest())
        pathlib.Path('/tmp/veux-r55c1/R55C1_SHELLCHECK.log').write_text('\n'.join(logs)+'\n')
        print('R55C1_YAML_DUPLICATES_PINS_ALL_SHELL_BLOCKS=PASS')
        PY_R55C1_YAML_AUDIT
    - name: 25 positive negative compiled C and synthetic full Git replay tests
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        python3 -B - <<'PY_R55C1_AST'
        import ast,pathlib
        stage=pathlib.Path('/tmp/veux-r55c1')
        for p in ('scripts/r55c1_proc_map.py','tests/test_r55c1_proc_map.py'):
            ast.parse((stage/p).read_text('utf-8'))
        print('R55C1_PYTHON_AST=PASS')
        PY_R55C1_AST
        python3 -B -m unittest discover -s "$R55_STAGE/tests" -p 'test_*.py' -v 2>&1 | tee "$R55_STAGE/R55C1_TESTS.log"

    - name: Replay R55B4-R2 and port real pinned proc base SUS_MAP
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        python3 -B "$R55_STAGE/scripts/r55c1_proc_map.py"   --source kernel --base "$R55_STAGE/inputs/R55B4_R2_AUTHENTIC_15FILES.patch"   --out "$R55_STAGE/out" 2>&1 | tee "$R55_STAGE/R55C1_REAL_SOURCE.log"
        python3 -B - <<'PY_R55C1_REAL_POSTCHECK'
        import pathlib,hashlib,json
        out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/veux-r55c1/out')
        r=json.loads((out/'R55C1_RESULT.json').read_text())
        assert r['files_total']==16 and not r['kernel_compiled'] and not r['flash_allowed']
        assert r['r55b4_r2_input_sha256']=='11c586cdb1d9305b34d4b70b32ad18f38f05037682dfaae359f7a0719878f743'
        assert hashlib.sha256((out/'VEUX_R55C1_SUSFS54_16_FILES_PROC_SUS_MAP_NOFLASH.patch').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['complete_16_file_patch_sha256']
        print('R55C1_REAL_SOURCE_POSTCHECK=PASS')
        PY_R55C1_REAL_POSTCHECK
    - name: Independent clean 16-file source Git replay
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        git -C kernel worktree add --detach "$R55_STAGE/replay" b2b7a3bbc36d120ee523ebc8d68e0f13a97df632
        total="$R55_STAGE/out/VEUX_R55C1_SUSFS54_16_FILES_PROC_SUS_MAP_NOFLASH.patch"
        git -C "$R55_STAGE/replay" apply --check --whitespace=error "$total"
        git -C "$R55_STAGE/replay" apply --whitespace=error "$total"
        # Three SUSFS source files are new: make git diff include all three, without committing.
        git -C "$R55_STAGE/replay" add -N -- fs/susfs.c include/linux/susfs.h include/linux/susfs_def.h
        git -C "$R55_STAGE/replay" diff --check
        python3 -B - <<'PY_R55C1_REPLAY'
        import pathlib,hashlib,subprocess,json,sys
        root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/veux-r55c1');kernel=pathlib.Path('kernel');replay=root/'replay';out=root/'out'
        sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
        import r55c1_proc_map as p
        scope=set(subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(replay),'diff','--name-only'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines())
        assert scope==p.EXPECTED,('MISMATCH',sorted(scope^p.EXPECTED))
        for name in sorted(p.EXPECTED):
            a=(kernel/name).read_bytes();b=(replay/name).read_bytes()
            assert hashlib.sha256(a).digest()==hashlib.sha256(b).digest(),name
        patch=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(replay),'diff','--binary','--no-ext-diff'],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
        assert patch==(out/p.TOTAL_NAME).read_bytes()
        r=json.loads((out/p.RESULT_NAME).read_text())
        assert r['files_total']==16 and not r['boot_ready'] and not r['flash_allowed']
        r['source_replay_verified']=True
        (out/p.RESULT_NAME).write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
        print('R55C1_16_FILE_EXACT_GIT_REPLAY=PASS')
        PY_R55C1_REPLAY
    - name: Final 16-file scope SHA256 and NOFLASH gate
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        cp "$R55_STAGE/R55C1_ACTIONLINT.log" "$R55_STAGE/R55C1_SHELLCHECK.log"    "$R55_STAGE/R55C1_TESTS.log" "$R55_STAGE/R55C1_REAL_SOURCE.log" "$R55_STAGE/out/"
        python3 -B - <<'PY_R55C1_FINAL'
        import pathlib,hashlib,json
        out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/veux-r55c1/out')
        r=json.loads((out/'R55C1_RESULT.json').read_text('utf-8'))
        assert r['source_replay_verified'] and r['files_total']==16
        for key in ('kernel_compiled','full_susfs_port','baka_su_uapi6_integrated','nomount_v22_integrated','device_tested','brene_changed','vendor_changed','boot_ready','flash_allowed','user_repo_modified','proc_readlink_integrated'):
            assert r[key] is False,key
        files=sorted(p for p in out.iterdir() if p.is_file() and p.name!='SHA256SUMS.txt')
        assert len(files)==8,len(files)
        checks=''.join(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()+'  '+p.name+'\n' for p in files)
        (out/'SHA256SUMS.txt').write_text(checks)
        print('R55C1_FINAL_SCOPE_CHECKSUM_NOFLASH=PASS')
        PY_R55C1_FINAL
        (cd "$R55_STAGE/out" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt)
        test -z "$(git -C project status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
        echo 'R55C1_MAIN_REPO_UNCHANGED=YES; KERNEL_BUILD=NO; FLASH_ALLOWED=NO'
